name: Radio Group
description: Native mutually exclusive choice group for a small set of visible alternatives. The group owns the selected value, shared name, label, and required semantics while the private _Radio Option owns each option's local presentation.

props.name: label
props.description: Required visible group label rendered as the fieldset legend.

props.name: name
props.description: Required native name shared by every radio in the group.

props.name: options
props.description: Required structured option data. The public TypeScript API requires at least two entries; every entry has a unique value, label, optional description, and optional disabled flag.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Optional uncontrolled initial selected value. No option is selected automatically when omitted.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Optional callback invoked once when an enabled native radio becomes selected.

props.name: required
props.description: Group-required form semantics; defaults to the Figma source value and is applied consistently to every native radio.

representations.mapsTo: publicApi.required default true plus visual required indicator
current value/defaultValue and native checked state
native/CSS hover, focus-visible, active, and disabled states

anatomy.name: fieldset
anatomy.description: Semantic native grouping container for the related radio controls.

anatomy.name: legend
anatomy.description: Visible group label and optional required indicator naming the fieldset.

anatomy.name: options
anatomy.description: Vertical list of at least two private _Radio Option renderers.

semantics.element: fieldset containing native input type=radio controls
semantics.accessibleName: The visible legend provides the group accessible name; each radio is named by its own option label.
semantics.keyboardActivation: native radio-group keyboard behavior including browser-managed arrow-key movement; no custom roving tabindex
semantics.focus: native radio focus; the internal option reflects focus-visible with CSS
requirements: Radio Group requires at least two options; a one-option group is rejected at runtime and by the public TypeScript tuple shape.
Every option must provide a unique non-empty value so one selected value maps to exactly one radio.
Every native radio receives the same public name so browser mutual exclusion and form submission remain native.
Controlled value and uncontrolled defaultValue usage are both supported; providing both at once is not supported.
The component does not automatically select the first option when value/defaultValue are omitted.
Native radio behavior owns selection and keyboard interaction; no custom arrow-key or roving-tabindex state machine is added.
When required, required=true is applied consistently to every radio and the visible required indicator is aria-hidden.
Option descriptions are associated to their radio through aria-describedby.
Option-level disabled comes from option data; there is no group-level disabled public prop.
A selected disabled option remains selected; disabling an option never clears the current value.
Changing selection edits component state only; product save/pending/error workflows remain outside Radio Group.
Member/Admin labels and Member preselection are Storybook/product fixtures, never reusable component logic.

options.description: The public data model maps to internal _Radio Option renderers only. Arbitrary children cannot replace the governed option anatomy.
